lines.zh: 钢靴踩过草地，草叶伏下去
lines.en: Steel boots cross the grass and the blades bow.

lines.zh: 长剑挂在腰间，剑鞘磕着腿
lines.en: My long sword knocks against my thigh.

lines.zh: 胸甲擦得发亮，能照见云
lines.en: My breastplate is polished enough to hold clouds.

lines.zh: 头盔上的面罩只开一道缝
lines.en: My visor leaves one narrow slit.

lines.zh: 我走去前方的岗哨换班
lines.en: I walk to the forward post to take the watch.

lines.zh: 剑柄上的皮革被我握得发亮
lines.en: The leather on my hilt shines from my grip.

lines.zh: 二十点护甲，走得像堵墙
lines.en: Twenty armor, moving like a wall.

lines.zh: 铁片在膝弯处互相摩擦
lines.en: The plates rub together behind my knee.

lines.zh: 我把披风从肩上抖开
lines.en: I shake the cloak off my shoulder.

lines.zh: 剑尖离地两寸，一路不碰土
lines.en: My point rides two inches up, never touching soil.

lines.zh: 我绕过泥坑，护腿没沾脏
lines.en: I round a puddle and keep my greaves clean.

lines.zh: 我停下看地图，又折向西
lines.en: I stop at a map, then turn west.

lines.zh: 我立着不动，像插在地上的旗杆
lines.en: I stand still as a planted standard.

lines.zh: 剑插在面前，双手搭在柄上
lines.en: Sword planted before me, both hands on the pommel.

lines.zh: 我抬眼望了一眼塔楼
lines.en: I glance up at the tower.

lines.zh: 呼吸在面罩里来回撞
lines.en: My breath bounces back off the visor.

lines.zh: 铁甲晒得温热，我不脱
lines.en: The sun warms my armor; I do not take it off.

lines.zh: 我把剑穗顺了顺
lines.en: I smooth the tassel on my sword.

lines.zh: 岗哨该换人了，还没来
lines.en: The watch should have changed by now.

lines.zh: 我在心里默数巡逻的圈数
lines.en: I count the patrol laps in my head.

lines.zh: 风掀起披风的一角，又落下
lines.en: Wind lifts a corner of my cloak, then drops it.

lines.zh: 我抬手按住头盔的护颊
lines.en: I press a hand to my helm's cheek guard.

lines.zh: 剑鞘上的纹路被我摸了几遍
lines.en: I trace the scabbard's chasing again and again.

lines.zh: 我把盾牌挪正，靠在腿边
lines.en: I straighten my shield and prop it at my leg.

lines.zh: 我隔着面罩看你，不动声色
lines.en: I watch you through the visor, giving nothing away.

lines.zh: 你的衣服上有泥，走了很远
lines.en: Your clothes are muddy; you came far.

lines.zh: 我把剑从土里拔出来，慢慢
lines.en: Slowly I draw the sword from the earth.

lines.zh: 你没有徽记，我不必客气
lines.en: You bear no sigil; I need no courtesy.

lines.zh: 面罩后的眼睛一直没眨
lines.en: The eyes behind the visor have not blinked.

lines.zh: 我抬起下巴，等你报上名
lines.en: I lift my chin and wait for your name.

lines.zh: 我扫了一眼你的腰带
lines.en: My glance goes to your belt.

lines.zh: 这身甲不是给你看的
lines.en: This armor is not here for show.

lines.zh: 你站的位置，正好在剑程里
lines.en: You stand exactly within my reach.

lines.zh: 我把剑横过来，挡在身前
lines.en: I bring the sword across my body.

lines.zh: 我摘下一只铁手套又戴上
lines.en: I pull off one gauntlet, then put it back on.

lines.zh: 你站的地方，正是我守的门
lines.en: You stand exactly where my gate is.

lines.zh: 甲上被砍出一道痕
lines.en: A cut is left across my plate.

lines.zh: 我退了半步，脚跟顶住
lines.en: I give half a step and my heel digs in.

lines.zh: 剑差点被震脱手
lines.en: The sword nearly leaves my grip.

lines.zh: 面罩歪了，视线发花
lines.en: My visor is askew and my sight swims.

lines.zh: 这一下打在我肋侧的缝
lines.en: That blow found the seam at my ribs.

lines.zh: 我闷哼一声，血往喉咙里涌
lines.en: I grunt; blood rises in my throat.

lines.zh: 护膝一软，我撑住了
lines.en: My knee buckles and I catch myself.

lines.zh: 铁甲的重量忽然变沉
lines.en: My armor suddenly feels heavier.

lines.zh: 我扶住剑，撑住身体
lines.en: I lean on the sword to hold myself up.

lines.zh: 肩上挨了一记，抬臂发疼
lines.en: A hit on my shoulder makes my arm ache.

lines.zh: 你袋里的东西闻着像蜜
lines.en: What is in your sack smells of honey.

lines.zh: 我一天没吃东西了
lines.en: I have not eaten all day.

lines.zh: 铁手套把面包捏扁了
lines.en: My gauntlet flattens the bread.

lines.zh: 我盯着你的手，不是你的脸
lines.en: I watch your hands, not your face.

lines.zh: 肚子响得比甲片还响
lines.en: My stomach is louder than my plates.

lines.zh: 我把剑换到左手，腾出右手
lines.en: I shift the sword to my left hand.

lines.zh: 就一口，我发誓不砍你
lines.en: One bite, and I swear not to cut you.

lines.zh: 这味道比酒馆的浓汤好
lines.en: Better than the tavern's stew, this smell.

lines.zh: 我闻着就想起家里的炉火
lines.en: The smell takes me back to my own hearth.

lines.zh: 我往前挪了一步，剑还举着
lines.en: I take one step nearer, sword still up.

lines.zh: 铁肩撞过来，把你挤开半步
lines.en: My iron shoulder shoves you back a step.

lines.zh: 我们相撞，剑鞘当啷响了一声
lines.en: We collide and the scabbard clangs.

lines.zh: 你撞在胸甲上，往后仰
lines.en: You hit my breastplate and tip backward.

lines.zh: 我按住你的肩，稳住两个人
lines.en: I grip your shoulder and steady us both.

lines.zh: 护膝磕到你的小腿
lines.en: My poleyn raps your shin.

lines.zh: 别贴太近，长剑需要地方
lines.en: Do not press in; a long sword needs room.

lines.zh: 披风被我们踩在脚下
lines.en: Our feet catch the cloak underfoot.

lines.zh: 你退开时衣角还挂在我甲扣上
lines.en: Your hem snags my armor clasp as you pull away.

lines.zh: 我半步没退，只是侧了侧身
lines.en: I do not yield, only turn slightly.

lines.zh: 你的额头顶到我的胸甲上
lines.en: Your forehead meets my breastplate.

lines.zh: 她替我把面罩推上去
lines.en: She pushes my visor up for me.

lines.zh: 我们额头相抵，铁碰着铁
lines.en: Our brows touch, iron against iron.

lines.zh: 她的手在我胸甲上停了一会
lines.en: Her hand rests a while on my breastplate.

lines.zh: 两把长剑靠在墙边，剑尖朝上
lines.en: Two long swords lean against the wall.

lines.zh: 我替她解开肩甲的扣
lines.en: I unfasten the clasp of her pauldron.

lines.zh: 盔甲里面也有心跳
lines.en: There are heartbeats inside armor too.

lines.zh: 我们把披风并排铺在地上
lines.en: We lay our cloaks side by side.

lines.zh: 不说话，只看同一堆火
lines.en: No words; we just watch the same fire.

lines.zh: 她笑的时候，面罩起了雾
lines.en: When she laughs, my visor fogs.

lines.zh: 我答应她明天一起巡西墙
lines.en: I promise to patrol the west wall with her.

lines.zh: 我弯腰，甲片卡了一下
lines.en: I bend and my plates catch.

lines.zh: 剑夹在腋下，我腾手捡东西
lines.en: Sword under my arm, I free a hand to pick it up.

lines.zh: 我拾起一枚掉落的马蹄铁
lines.en: I pick up a dropped horseshoe.

lines.zh: 磨刀石塞进腰后的袋子
lines.en: A whetstone goes into the pouch at my back.

lines.zh: 我捡起地上断掉的箭杆
lines.en: I pick up a broken arrow shaft.

lines.zh: 捡起那面旧盾，掂了掂
lines.en: I lift an old shield and weigh it.

lines.zh: 铁手套笨，抓了两次才起来
lines.en: My gauntlet is clumsy; it takes two tries.

lines.zh: 我拾起一枚崩掉的剑尖碎片
lines.en: I pick up a broken shard of a sword point.

lines.zh: 地上的绳子，我卷好收着
lines.en: I coil a rope from the ground and keep it.

lines.zh: 我跪下一条腿去够远处的东西
lines.en: I go down on one knee to reach it.

lines.zh: 剑抬到胸口，我看定你
lines.en: Sword at chest height, I fix on you.

lines.zh: 我把面罩压低了一点
lines.en: I settle my visor lower.

lines.zh: 你已经在我剑程之内
lines.en: You are already within my reach.

lines.zh: 我的脚分开，重心沉下去
lines.en: I spread my feet and sink my weight.

lines.zh: 你不是骑士，那就简单了
lines.en: You are no knight; that simplifies things.

lines.zh: 剑尖朝你,我等你先动
lines.en: Point at you, I wait for you to move first.

lines.zh: 这一战我接下来了
lines.en: I accept this fight.

lines.zh: 我侧过身，剑藏在披风后
lines.en: I turn sideways, sword hidden past my cloak.

lines.zh: 你退也退不出这块地
lines.en: Retreat will not take you off this ground.

lines.zh: 我数过你的步幅，正合我意
lines.en: I have measured your stride; it suits me.

lines.zh: 你的手握得太紧，指节白了
lines.en: Your grip is too tight; your knuckles are white.

lines.zh: 我把剑举起,像在宣判
lines.en: I raise the sword as if pronouncing sentence.

lines.zh: 风吹开披风，我的影子罩住你
lines.en: Wind parts my cloak; my shadow covers you.

lines.zh: 我听见你的呼吸变快了
lines.en: I hear your breathing quicken.

lines.zh: 我一步步跟着，剑不离你的胸
lines.en: I pace you, the sword never leaving your chest.

lines.zh: 你向左，我封左边
lines.en: You go left; I close the left.

lines.zh: 距离七步，长剑正好
lines.en: Seven paces: exactly a long sword's reach.

lines.zh: 我不急，甲厚，撑得起
lines.en: I am in no rush; thick armor can afford it.

lines.zh: 你抬手，我就知道你要劈
lines.en: You lift a hand and I know a chop is coming.

lines.zh: 披风挡住你的视线
lines.en: My cloak blocks your line of sight.

lines.zh: 我压低剑尖，找你的腿
lines.en: I drop the point to seek your legs.

lines.zh: 你换脚了，重心偏了
lines.en: You changed feet; your balance slipped.

lines.zh: 再退就是灌木，没路了
lines.en: Back further and it is brush; no path.

lines.zh: 我不喊，喊话费力气
lines.en: I do not shout; shouting wastes strength.

lines.zh: 你每次后退都慢半拍
lines.en: Every retreat of yours is half a beat late.

lines.zh: 我绕着你走，甲片轻响
lines.en: I circle you, plates whispering.

lines.zh: 我不冲，等你自己撞上来
lines.en: I do not charge; I wait for you to come.

lines.zh: 你的兵器太短，我压着距离
lines.en: Your weapon is short; I hold the distance.

lines.zh: 剑尖画着圈，圈越来越小
lines.en: The point draws circles, each one narrower.

lines.zh: 我顺着你的影子走，不抢前
lines.en: I follow your shadow without rushing.

lines.zh: 你踩进泥里，脚慢了一瞬
lines.en: You step in mud; your foot slows a beat.

lines.zh: 长剑自上而下劈落
lines.en: My long sword falls from above.

lines.zh: 我一步踏进去，剑尖直取
lines.en: I step in and drive the point home.

lines.zh: 剑刃刮过你的护肩
lines.en: The edge scrapes across your shoulder guard.

lines.zh: 我用手腕转剑，换了个角度
lines.en: I roll my wrist and change the angle.

lines.zh: 你一挡，我顺势用剑柄撞
lines.en: You block; I ram the pommel at you.

lines.zh: 铁靴踹向你的膝窝
lines.en: My steel boot kicks at the back of your knee.

lines.zh: 剑身横拍，声音很闷
lines.en: The flat of the blade slaps you, dull and heavy.

lines.zh: 这一剑我留了力，你却退了三步
lines.en: I held back, and still you fell back three steps.

lines.zh: 剑尖挑开你的衣襟
lines.en: The point flicks open your coat.

lines.zh: 我连劈两记，第二记偏上
lines.en: I cut twice; the second rides high.

lines.zh: 面罩挡着，我凭感觉出剑
lines.en: My visor blinds me; I strike by feel.

lines.zh: 你格住剑，我压下去
lines.en: You catch the blade; I press down.

lines.zh: 我抬脚踩你的盾沿
lines.en: I set my boot on your shield rim.

lines.zh: 剑从你腋下穿过，割开衣里
lines.en: The blade slips under your arm and parts cloth.

lines.zh: 我顶着你的兵器往前推
lines.en: I lean into your weapon and push forward.

lines.zh: 剑锋擦过盾面，火星迸出
lines.en: The edge rakes the shield and sparks jump.

lines.zh: 我用手肘撞你的太阳穴
lines.en: My elbow drives at your temple.

lines.zh: 一剑未中，我立刻换招
lines.en: The cut misses; I change the stroke at once.

lines.zh: 我把剑从鞘里抽出来，慢而稳
lines.en: I draw the sword, slow and steady.

lines.zh: 铁甲在夕阳下泛红
lines.en: My armor turns red in the low sun.

lines.zh: 我踏上这片地，草被压平
lines.en: I step onto this ground and the grass lies flat.

lines.zh: 剑尖抵地，我环视一圈
lines.en: Point to earth, I survey the field.

lines.zh: 披风在身后落下
lines.en: My cloak settles behind me.

lines.zh: 有人需要一名骑士，我来了
lines.en: Someone needed a knight; I have come.

lines.zh: 二十点护甲，一把长剑
lines.en: Twenty armor and one long sword.

lines.zh: 面罩合上，我换了口气
lines.en: The visor closes and I take a breath.

lines.zh: 我把剑往地上一顿，尘土跳起
lines.en: I stamp the sword down and dust leaps.

lines.zh: 披风扫过草尖，草伏了一片
lines.en: My cloak sweeps the grass flat.

lines.zh: 远处有人吹号，我应了一声
lines.en: A horn sounds far off and I answer it.

lines.zh: 我从门洞里走出来，铁甲回响
lines.en: I step out of the archway, armor echoing.

lines.zh: 火烤得胸甲发烫，贴着肉疼
lines.en: The fire heats my breastplate until it bites.

lines.zh: 我从墙上跌下，甲先砸在地上
lines.en: I fall from the wall, armor hitting first.

lines.zh: 水灌进面罩，我一口气没接上
lines.en: Water floods my visor and my breath cuts off.

lines.zh: 爆风把我掀得转了半圈
lines.en: The blast spins me half around.

lines.zh: 一支弩箭咬进我的肩甲
lines.en: A crossbow bolt bites into my pauldron.

lines.zh: 咒力透过铁甲，直钻进骨头
lines.en: Magic passes through the steel into my bones.

lines.zh: 空着肚子站岗，腿发软
lines.en: Standing watch unfed, my legs go soft.

lines.zh: 雷顺着长剑走，我整条臂都麻了
lines.en: Lightning runs down my sword and numbs my arm.

lines.zh: 脚下没有地，我抓着剑往下掉
lines.en: No ground below; I clutch my sword and fall.
